purpose: Gothic supernatural archetype references; names in the game are original
layout: 3 columns x 5 rows, transparent background, painted anime full-body cutouts
prompts: Trevor Belmont: rugged brown haired bearded hunter wearing fur trimmed brown coat with silver whip. Sypha Belnades: short auburn hair, flowing pale blue speaker robes, ice flame in hand. Alucard: tall pale golden longhaired elegant dhampir, black gold embroidered longcoat and floating silver sword. Dracula: imposing pale black longhair red lined black cape, pointed beard, regal vampire. Lisa Tepes: kind blonde physician in burgundy dress, medical satchel. Isaac: black shaved head forgemaster, dark leather coat, blue magic dagger. Hector: silver haired forgemaster blue grey tunic, hammer and violet spirits. Carmilla: pale platinum longhaired vampire queen in crimson fitted dress, crimson blade. Lenore: auburn longhaired vampire diplomat, pale lacy gothic dress with burgundy cape. Striga: broad powerful dark haired female vampire in massive black silver plate armor holding greatsword. Morana: elegant dark skinned female vampire strategist in black violet tailored gown with ledger. Saint Germain: middle aged auburn bearded alchemist in green Victorian coat, top hat, golden portal. The Adventurer: athletic short redhaired woman in green leather explorer clothes wielding sword.

Sumi: Japanese young woman long black hair in blue tunic with katana. Taka: Japanese young man black hair in brown coat with bow. Greta: dark skinned leader brown braids wearing earthy green armor and spear. Zamfir: stern tan brown haired female captain in layered blue grey armor, blade. Ratko: broad monstrous bald vampire officer in brass armor, saber. Death: towering skeletal hooded reaper in flowing purple black shroud carrying ornate scythe. Godbrand: red bearded muscular viking vampire with twin axes, fur cloak. Cho: pale East Asian vampire queen in red gold robes, sharp silver headdress. Raman: Indian vampire lord red turban ornate crimson gold armor scimitar. Sharma: Indian female vampire long black hair crimson silk gilded armor curved sword. Slogra: lanky beaked bone demon, brass spear, elongated limbs. Gaibon: powerful blue winged bat demon, horned head. Blue Fangs: monstrous slate blue wolf demon with exaggerated azure teeth.

The Visitor: horned black winged multi-eyed night creature, purple hellfire. Flyseyes: thoughtful insect night creature with compound orange eyes blue shell and green scarf. Abel: noble pale winged demon, gray white skin, feathered wing, silver cuirass. The Captain: middleaged brown skinned sea captain long brown coat tricorn hat, curved saber. Sala: bald monk cultist brown robes violet sigils, crooked staff. The Judge: severe middleaged pale man black hair in burgundy civic robes holding a seal. The Bishop: gaunt sinister bishop red golden ecclesiastical robes tall mitre and gilded staff. Richter Belmont: young brown hair hunter blue coat with white collar, bandana, flaming silver whip. Maria Renard: teenage blonde with ponytail, green belted tunic brown shorts, spectral bird, age appropriate. Annette: athletic young black woman white curls wearing blue cream clothes, curved metal blades and earth magic. Edouard: tall gentle green winged singer nightcreature with human face, blue luminous aura. Tera: blonde middleaged speaker in long white pale blue dress, red moon magic. Julia Belmont: long brown haired hunter in white blue outfit with magic whip.

Juste Belmont: elder long white hair man red layered coat, ice and fire in hands. Olrox: Native American elegant vampire, long black hair, dark green embroidered coat, emerald serpent spirit. Mizrak: muscular bearded knight dark hair leather armor and longsword. Drolta Tzuentes: dark skinned vampire priestess, short bright pink hair, black fitted armor and bat wings. Erzsebet Bathory: tall platinum blonde vampire queen, white gilded gown, black red eclipse halo, feline eyes. Emmanuel the Abbot: middleaged black haired priest brown robes, golden cross and soul forge sigil. Cecile: dignified older black woman with headwrap blue violet dress, ancestral staff. Vaublanc: pale French vampire aristocrat powdered white wig in gold cream coat, rapier. Jacques: green muscular humanoid winged night creature in torn blue clothes, luminous eyes. Sekhmet: majestic golden lion headed goddess in Egyptian gilded red attire, solar staff. Vermilion Bird: red golden magical phoenix, winged guardian creature. White Tiger: large white tiger with black stripes and cobalt spirit flames. Black Tortoise: gigantic black green armored tortoise wrapped by serpent, turquoise magical aura. Azure Dragon: long sinuous blue eastern dragon with silver horns, emerald mane.
